title: An over-broad context causes the tool response to be wrong

source.controller.py:
request = read_request()
context = select_context(request)
observation = call_tool(context)
return observation

events.observation: The learner request is available to the controller.
The context packet includes an unrelated file.
The tool response is not the requested build status.

assertions.description: Context contains only the requested status input.
Reading status returns green for this fixture.

text_fallback: At e1 the controller includes an unrelated file, violating the context invariant. At e2 the tool returns unknown rather than green, so the prediction fails.
